recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No source follow-up is needed for FHIR-46963 unless OO later changes the DeviceAssociation modeling guidance for device-setting Observations.
issue_request: FHIR-46963 was an Applied FHIR-core OO change request, resolved Persuasive with Modification, asking to replace misleading DeviceAssociation boundaries-and-relationships prose that implied device-setting Observations would have a patient subject, device, and time window. The approved direction was to state that Observation.subject references the Device whose settings apply, and that patient context can be found through the DeviceAssociation whose period includes Observation.effective[x].
initial_application: Commit bd4f31db0f9fbbde6a65054d8fcd69986569e4cc explicitly applied FHIR-46963 to source/deviceassociation/deviceassociation-introduction.xml by replacing the old sentence. Historical commit 2cfdd9c837592f22e50fa54e7d6635d5746c0397 introduced the old guidance that the Jira later corrected.
additional_context: source/fhir.ini actively lists deviceassociation=DeviceAssociation, so the inspected DeviceAssociation narrative is in build scope. OO HCP Confluence minutes show the issue was prepared for block vote on 2025-02-10 and included in the 2025-03-10 8-0-1 block vote. FHIR-46968 appeared in the same DeviceAssociation block-vote trail but concerns operation/operator guidance, already has a combined-branch audit commit, and does not change this settings guidance.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit. The current active source already says Observation.subject references the Device that the settings apply to and uses DeviceAssociation.period containing Observation.effective[x] to identify the associated patient. Searches found no stale old wording in active non-SVG DeviceAssociation source and no conflicting Zulip discussion.
